candidate_rule: Use this session final checkpoint, selected before inspecting any acceptance outcomes; no best-stage selection.
sampling: stochastic, same World 1-1 saved start and recovery-v2 protocol
success_rule: All 20 unique predetermined trials complete with valid telemetry; at least 18 verified level clears. Deaths and frame limits are failures. Incomplete evaluations cannot pass.
note: Additional evaluation only, not extra training. Do not silently retry failed seeds or tune on this set and reuse it as a fresh acceptance test.
